- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in early days of the 30-day window; apply downward bias correction for first 5–7 days.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >90.5), model overshoots and fails to correct — reduce forecast by 1–2% for 3–5 days post-spike.
- Mean reversion is strong in late window (last 7–10 days); model tends to overpredict, so apply downward adjustment of 0.5–1.5% per day for final 10 days.
- Lagged response: model often lags true price drops by 2–4 days — adjust forecast downward by 0.5–1.0% per day for 2–4 days after observed drop.
- Avoid linear extrapolation — price volatility is non-linear; use smoothing or exponential decay for trend correction.
